title: Spectral sparsity of a path indicator
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\alpha$ be a type, and let a path on the binary cube of dimension $n$ have output in $\alpha$. The spectral sparsity of the indicator of the set of binary vectors matching the path is $2^\ell$, where $\ell$ is the number of coordinates in the path's support.
hypotheses_covered: A path on the binary cube of dimension n with output in α
